glossary.definition: (B) A lessor is not liable under section 1351.08 of the Revised Code for damages in excess of the actual damage sustained by the lessee if the lessor shows by a preponderance of the evidence that the violation of this chapter resulted from a bona fide error notwithstanding the maintenance by the lessor of procedures reasonably adopted to avoid the error. As used in this division, "bona fide error" includes, but is not limited to, clerical, calculation, computer malfunction and programming, and printing errors.
